screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high fidelity desktop application screenshot for Trace, landscape 16:9, ideally 2048x1152. Full flat front-facing screen, no laptop/device frame, no multi-screen collage, no presentation annotations.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: retain Trace identity, ivory / celadon / deep forest green, tiny restrained amber accents, thin ink tributaries, elegant translucent bubble geometry. Redesign composition for a usable focused application. Much quieter than the reference: paper-white legible reading surfaces, subtle glass edges, ink wash only near perimeter and bottom; no background detail behind text, no huge glowing 3D waves or low-contrast transparent text.
All four screens in this set share identical shell: top-left small forest green Trace symbol and black Trace wordmark; breadcrumb “收藏后为什么接不回来 / 找个对照”; top-right quiet button “返回原来的事情”; small “演示内容” label (all examples are illustrative, not verified real Zhihu sources); a small circular profile avatar alone at lower left. NO left sidebar, NO navigation rail. Headings 32-40px equivalent, clear Chinese sans-serif body 18-22px equivalent, comfortably spaced. Product workspace, not a marketing landing page. Understated Chinese editorial character, readable functional controls. At most one tiny abstract ink bird by the current focus, never flocks or birds in every corner.
Product continuity: one user is examining whether writing a personal note when saving an article is NECESSARY to resume thinking later. A candidate example has no saving note but a continuing project restores the reading context. It may LIMIT a universal claim, not automatically refute it. Generated examples clearly identified as “演示材料”. Citation snippets, AI inference and user writing must look distinct. Relations are tentative until accepted. Real experience is source type, NOT a separate semantic relationship alongside support/challenge/limit.
No percent confidence, no fake verified quotes or famous creator names, no metrics, no dense knowledge graph, no fixed four-category branches, no chat transcript. No English lorem ipsum, no extra prose. Reproduce specified Chinese copy accurately, reduce extra text rather than tiny gibberish. Preserve clear primary action and secondary exits.
SCREEN 1 OF 4 — entry and grounded search, BEFORE results exist.
Title “从这一处找”, small subtitle “不用重新交代背景，就从这句话开始。”
Layout: a quiet spacious two-object composition, not a grid. At mid-left, a selected thought as an organic white bubble labeled “正在推敲的一句”; text “收藏时必须留下自己的表达，之后才能接回来。” Highlight only “必须” with pale amber underline. A fine thread connects the thought to the larger focused search surface at center-right.
Search surface title “这次想弄清楚”; editable question “写下自己的表达，是以后接回来的必要条件吗？” small text button “修改这一处”.
Below, modest suggestion chips “找个反例” (selected), “看看别人怎么做”, “换一种条件”.
A spacious input containing “找找没有写附言，却仍能重新使用内容的情况。”
Footer row inside surface: “查找范围：既往思考 · 知乎公开内容” as quiet dropdown; subtle paperclip link “已有材料，直接带入”; strong green primary “开始找”. Secondary quiet “先放着”.
Under the search surface small helper “假设情形会单独标明，不会作为真实案例。”
No candidates yet, no fabricated completed state. Make thought anchor and search direction immediately comprehensible. Single small bird at the connecting thread's search end.
